summary: Broad non-P0 source/accessibility/evidence swarm moved from an initially wrong invisible-control ban to a Unicode-correct collision-safe evidence projection, with regression source, durable skill doctrine, touchable Swan Veil art, and bounded reviews.

fronts_advanced.result: HeartbeatInvisibleSemanticControlPolicy now preserves legitimate invisible layout/shaping semantics and provides deterministic explicit evidence markers with literal-backslash escaping.
Fixtures cover ZWSP/WJ/FEFF reveal, ZWJ/ZWNJ reveal, ordinary Unicode pass-through, existing bidi/ISO safety separation, source preservation, and marker collision prevention.
Added heartbeat-invisible-semantic-controls skill with the Unicode correction scar, evidence projection law, capability membrane, accessibility doctrine, and P0 firewall.

Added touchable Swan Veil DOM/inline-SVG specimen with explicit source-versus-evidence projection, 48px controls, keyboard focus, aria-pressed selection, polite live status, reduced-motion handling, and a literal-marker collision case.
Pre-mutation plan, Venice plan gate, corrective replan, Regnet review, and Venice bounded completion review are durable in the repository.
Primary Unicode evidence invalidated the initial blanket-ban assumption; the source strategy was materially changed from reject to reveal.

cross_pollination: Existing semantic-safety archaeology exposed the invisible-text legibility question.
Unicode primary evidence disproved the initial rejection assumption and forced an Originality-Tax replan.
Accessibility converted the goal from rejection to explicit on-demand evidence visibility.
Evidence discipline exposed an inline-marker alias collision, so literal backslashes became an escaped marker namespace.
The collision fix propagated into regression source, skill doctrine, and the touchable Swan Veil artifact.
Regnet/Venice prevented policy/art progress from being promoted into parser, Android, TalkBack, test, or delivery capability.
